runtime.retry_backoff: 1,2 seconds; total attempt budget shared by transport/incomplete/schema

selection_boundary: Non-oracle plans consume gold-free test runtime views and contain identifiers only. Oracle consumes evaluator potential-graph structure but no outcome values. Matched retrieval ranks nodes, history, and edges query-aware under separately matched learned-arm budgets.
gold_access: Oracle graph structure during oracle-plan construction; all outcome fields only after API generation for scoring.
invalid_response_policy: Transport, incomplete completion, and strict schema failures receive at most the frozen retry budget with identical prompt and seed. Unresolved engineering failures reduce semantic coverage and make the experiment incomplete; they are not semantic zeroes.
